title: Israel strikes Iran (13 Jun 2025)
description: Israel struck Iranian nuclear and missile sites shortly after midnight UTC on 13 June 2025, and Iran answered with drones. BTC fell about 2% within the hour while gold rallied.

markets.proxy: PAXG (gold-backed token) as the gold price

headlines.title: Israel strikes Iran nuclear facilities, missile factories
headlines.tsNote: Reuters headline (syndicated copy). Strikes began around 03:00 Tehran time (about 23:30 UTC on 12 Jun); minute of publication not verified.

headlines.title: Israel hits Iran nuclear, missile facilities; Tehran launches drones
headlines.tsNote: Updated Reuters headline on 13 Jun 2025 after Iran's drone launch; minute not verified.

headlines.title: Israel hits Iran nuclear and missile facilities, appears to block retaliation
headlines.tsNote: Later Reuters update dated 13 Jun 2025; minute not verified.

sources: Prices: Binance public klines BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT and PAXGUSDT, 15m (data-api.binance.vision). Gold is the PAXG proxy, not a gold future.
